scientific_decisions.source_name: Existing big bluestem photos and historic herbarium labels
scientific_decisions.action: Nomenclatural synonymy does not verify an individual plant or its variety; leave original identification and visual proof holds untouched.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Individual big bluestem × sand bluestem hybrid or introgressed specimen
scientific_decisions.action: Documented hybridization does not prove a particular specimen is a hybrid; do not assign hybrid ancestry without diagnostic voucher or genetic evidence.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Species versus subspecies rank of sand bluestem across authorities
scientific_decisions.action: POWO/WCVP 2026 accepts A. hallii as species and synonymizes subsp. hallii; ITIS accepts A. gerardii subsp. hallii. Keep both source-qualified treatments; use POWO for project accepted backbone.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Historical Andropogon chrysocomus / putative hybrid observation without voucher
scientific_decisions.action: POWO lists A. chrysocomus under var. gerardi; cytogenetic review discusses a historical A. chrysocomus collection as hybrid material. Name mapping is resolved under Kew, but the biological interpretation of any unlabeled historic specimen is not.
